The board has 36 cells, numbered 0 to 35 in row-major order.
Cell $k$ corresponds to row $r = k // 6$ and column $c = k \% 6$.
A knight moves from $(r, c)$ to $(r', c')$ if $(|r-r'|, |c-c'|)$ is $(1, 2)$ or $(2, 1)$.
The tour must visit every cell exactly once.
The sequence of visited cells is $x_0, x_1, \dots, x_{35}$.
$x_0$ must be 0.
The sequence must be a permutation of $0, \dots, 35$.

Distance between $x_i$ and $x_j$ is $|i - j|$.
The knight distance on the board must be $\le |i - j|$ and have the same parity (bipartite graph).
